title: Classic Italian Lasagna
description: A traditional Italian dish made with ground beef, lasagna noodles, and a rich tomato sauce. This recipe is a hearty and satisfying meal for any occasion.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine ricotta cheese, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Spread a layer of the meat sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the meat sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles.
Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the meat sauce, then the ricotta cheese mixture, and finally the mozzarella cheese.
Top the lasagna with the shredded cheese and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
